title: Percentage of Full-time ITE Students on Internships
what_it_is: Percentage of Full-time ITE Students on Internships

sections.label: Compulsory ITE internship modules
sections.summary: Internship modules are compulsory in 68 of 98 ITE courses, with ITE targeting internships in all full-time Nitec and Higher Nitec courses by 2020.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills))
sentences.text: Currently, internship modules have been made compulsory in 68 out of 98 courses in the Institute of Technical Education (ITE).

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills))
sentences.text: ITE targets for all full-time National Institute of Technical Education Certificate (Nitec) and Higher Nitec courses to include internships by 2020.

sections.label: ITE graduate job relevance
sections.summary: In the 2016 Graduate Employment Survey, around 55% of ITE graduates in full-time permanent jobs reported working in jobs related to their course of study.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills))
sentences.text: Based on the results from the 2016 Graduate Employment Survey of the ITE graduates in full-time permanent jobs, around 55% reported that they were working in jobs related to their course of study.

sections.label: Education and career guidance counsellors
sections.summary: ECG was rolled out about two years ago, and there are now close to 100 education and career guidance counsellors in polytechnics, ITEs and secondary schools.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: ECG was rolled out about two years ago and, by now, we have close to 100 education and career guidance counsellors in the polytechnics, ITEs and also secondary schools.

sections.label: MOE and MTI internship support
sections.summary: MOE and MTI agencies like SPRING Singapore work closely with ITE through SME programmes to extend meaningful internship opportunities for ITE students.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: To this end, not just the Ministry of Education, but even the Ministry of Trade and Industry agencies like SPRING Singapore, through their small and medium enterprises (SME) Talent Programme and their SME Mentors' Programme, work very closely with ITE to extend meaningful internship opportunities for ITE students.

sections.label: ITE internship preparation and feedback
sections.summary: Lecturers and class coaches prepare students mentally, conduct pre-internship briefings, visit partner companies, and run a post-internship survey for student feedback.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: The lecturers and the class coaches play an integral role in terms of preparing the students well mentally before they go into an internship.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: This is why we conduct pre-internship briefings for students, so that the expectations of both the students and also the companies' side are fairly aligned.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: In addition, the ITE lecturers will pay regular visits to the partner companies to make sure that the students are doing well during the stint.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: After the internship stint, the ITE campus will conduct a post-internship survey where students can provide feedback on how their internship stint had been in terms of fulfilling the specified learning objectives by the ITE campus, whether it is East, West or Central, and also the class itself.
